en.goal: Identify effective messaging, creative and delivery approaches across active and concluded Google Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Meta, Reddit, EDM and social tests to guide Bluevua’s marketing and growth.
en.hypothesis: As an inferred synthesis rather than a documented program-wide hypothesis, communicating credible RO benefits and upgrade value through audience-appropriate content and delivery should improve engagement and purchase decisions efficiently.

zh.goal: 综合 Google Search、Performance Max、Demand Gen、Meta、Reddit、EDM 和社媒的进行中及已结束测试，识别有效的信息表达、创意与投放方式，为 Bluevua 的营销和增长提供依据。
zh.hypothesis: 以下为综合推断而非已记录的全项目统一假设：通过适合受众的内容与投放方式，可信地呈现 RO 的实际益处和升级价值，应能更有效地促进互动与购买决策。
